name: K-C Jenks Mill - Jenks OK
type: Tissue paper mill (Cottonelle, Scott bathroom tissue) with regional distribution center

fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied only a city-level address and a coordinate (35.9953,-95.9727) that landed in a Jenks residential subdivision ~10 km from the mill. Directory addresses (13252 S Yale Pl / 13219 S Kimberly-Clark Pl) geocode poorly. Resolved via a documented detail (Tulsa World): the mill 'sits on the Arkansas River between Jenks and Bixby' — a 1.8M sq ft factory on 342 acres. Found and confirmed the large riverside industrial complex at ~35.9715,-95.9272: a multi-building tissue mill + regional DC overlooking the Arkansas River, consistent with the facility (opened 1990).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SW corner where the long access road from the public road reaches the mill. z19 imagery shows a pinch-point with a gatehouse structure, marked lanes, and a parked truck in a staging position; Street View confirms a small gate building with a truck at the access road. Classed truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A gatehouse / canopied structure sits beside the checkpoint pinch-point at the truck entrance — classed as a guard shack. Resolution is limited at z20-21 so listed uncertain; remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.scale: The structure cluster at the entrance checkpoint is consistent with a truck scale / scale house alongside the gatehouse — classed scale true but listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: A truck is visible staged on the access road before the gate; the long approach provides pre-gate waiting room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long access road from the public road to the gate and on to the docks — easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard E of the main building with many long rows of parked trailers — 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the south face of the white warehouse/DC building with many trailers backed in; ~45 doors estimated — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No clear rail spur confirmed entering the property; some linear features near the SE could be rail or road. Listed uncertain; classed false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: integrated tissue mill, a large separate warehouse / regional distribution center, wastewater treatment plant, tank farm, and process buildings — multiple distinct building clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Large 320+ acre campus on the rural Arkansas River bank between Jenks and Bixby, surrounded by farmland and woods — Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and long approach road give ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Entry/exit lane counts estimated from the gate pinch-point — listed uncertain.
